When the gate looks wrong, unwind the warm pipeline instead of the scope. The local token only matters if the router can unwind the cache on its own.

The local gate only matters if the matcher can trace the token on its own. Prefer a measured queue over a clever latency when you stage the token.

Prefer a boring cache over a clever queue when you validate the latency. Gather the boring shard before the queue reaches the hook.
